name: Empirical development
scientific_purpose: Build a reproducible cumulative evidence base and current empirical synthesis for one exact method identity.

current_record_semantics.research_meaning: Immutable evidence accumulates, while the current index and synthesis include only evidence applicable to the exact method and current claims.
current_record_semantics.history_policy: Previous evidence remains traceable. Current runs use applicable exact-method evidence by default and exclude outdated evidence unless the user selects it.

user_choices.label: Method
user_choices.description: Select one active method and its current exact identity.

user_choices.label: Analysis instructions
user_choices.description: State the empirical question, data or simulation constraints, comparisons, and desired checks.

user_choices.label: Selected history
user_choices.description: Optionally include named historical evidence for a specific comparison or diagnostic.

run_modes.label: Preliminary
run_modes.purpose: Run a small set of decisive feasibility, implementation, and diagnostic checks.
entry_conditions: The project brief, Phase 1 basis, and Phase 2 catalog are current.
The selected method is active and current.

run_modes.label: Comprehensive
run_modes.purpose: Run a self-contained prespecified full evaluation with claim-linked comparisons, sensitivity analyses, robustness checks, and uncertainty assessment. Reuse prior code only when an exact current implementation exists and passes recorded verification checks.
entry_conditions: The project brief, Phase 1 basis, and Phase 2 catalog are current.
The selected method is active and current.

prerequisites.description: A formal current project brief is readable.
A formal current Phase 1 literature basis is readable.
The user selects one active current method from Phase 2.

required_inputs.purpose: Preserve the scientific problem and intended scope.
Ground comparisons, empirical precedents, interpretation, and biological or substantive context.
Confirm that the selected stable method is active and current.
Freeze the exact calculation-defining method that code and evidence must implement.
Identify applicable completed analyses and excluded outdated evidence.
required_inputs.condition: Required on reruns for the same exact identity and absent on the first run.

required_inputs.purpose: Identify the current conclusions and open checks that the run must update.
required_inputs.condition: Required on reruns for the same exact identity and absent on the first run.

required_inputs.purpose: Provide prior exact-method code, environment, and configuration when they exist. A run may reuse them only after recording digest, invariant, and fidelity checks; otherwise it replaces them.
required_inputs.condition: Required on reruns for the same exact identity and absent on the first run.

required_inputs.purpose: Expose assumptions, empirical implications, and boundary cases.
required_inputs.condition: Included when an exactly aligned Phase 3 record exists; Phase 3 is not a prerequisite.

optional_context_policy.description: The exact current method and applicable evidence are loaded by default. Outdated and historical evidence is excluded unless selected.

role_stages.objective: Apply the selected preliminary or comprehensive scope, finalize a claim-linked empirical protocol before inspecting outcomes, verify the exact implementation, execute only that protocol, append deviations without rewriting it, and produce reproducible evidence and synthesis.
Audit mathematical fidelity, definition-to-code correspondence, protocol adherence, scope-appropriate comparisons and thresholds, interpretation, deviations, and consistency with available theory.

Integrate evidence and fidelity findings without creating unaudited results, retain only applicable evidence, preserve protocol deviations and unresolved disagreement, and state a scope-calibrated scientific outcome and user-relevant changes. Before sealing, the lead performs the in-house scientific check: every claim in the empirical record and handoff must be linked to its supporting evidence or theory record, or recorded as a limitation or open question. An unlinked or unsupported claim is the lead's defect to resolve in-house, never the outside reviewer's discovery.

run_local_outputs.purpose: Prespecify claim-to-test links, estimand, data or simulation unit, baselines, implementation strategy, tuning budget, metrics, repetitions and uncertainty, multiplicity, stopping, leakage checks, decision thresholds, and append-only deviations for the selected scope.
Provide immutable results with method, code, data or simulation, configuration, seed, environment, and artifact provenance.
Distinguish new evidence from previously applicable evidence and state the first empirical interpretation.
Record stable mathematical-fidelity and interpretation issues.
Provide the candidate current index of exact-method evidence and explicit exclusions.
Provide the candidate complete empirical interpretation, uncertainty, limitations, and issue dispositions.
Provide the candidate current implementation identity, environment, configuration, and reproducibility references.
Record each newly identified research-attention item with its exact basis, affected claim or record, and smallest resolving question.
Summarize what the evidence supports, material changes, outdated components, and meaningful user actions.
State what was computed, what changed, and which fidelity questions require theorist review.
State method-fidelity findings, interpretation limits, and unresolved lead decisions.

validation_rules.description: Data analyst, theorist, and research lead outputs exist in that exact order with complete handoffs.
Every selected-method computation and claim names the exact stable ID, version, and definition digest.
Every evidence item records code, data or simulation, configuration, randomness, environment, and artifact provenance.
Outputs satisfy the declared preliminary or comprehensive scientific scope, its prespecified claim-linked protocol, thresholds, and recorded deviations without inferring scope from chronology.
The current index excludes mismatched-method, outdated, withdrawn, invalid, superseded, and unresolved evidence from current claims.
New evidence and the replacement index and synthesis commit as one transaction.

promotion.failure_behavior: Append no evidence and keep the prior index and synthesis unchanged; retain the candidate only in its run workspace.

downstream_effects.description: Evidence that contradicts or narrows a theory statement creates targeted Phase 3 attention without method-identity mismatch.
A current manuscript no longer has the latest empirical basis and requires user-started reconciliation.

researcher_questions: What evidence is valid for this exact method?
What did this run add or reclassify?

fields.label: Selected method
fields.meaning: Stable identity, mathematical definition, version, assumptions, and scope.

fields.label: Current evidence
fields.meaning: Applicable exact-method evidence with scope, provenance, and outcome.

fields.label: Not current
fields.meaning: Evidence excluded from current claims with a precise reason and retained provenance.

fields.label: What changed
fields.meaning: New results, changed interpretations, fidelity findings, and remaining decisions.
